headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss to the Cleveland Guardians, while the New York Yankees secured a victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, and the Boston Red Sox came from behind to edge the Baltimore Orioles.

Top MLB News
The Twins fell to the Guardians 13-4, with Petey Halpin leading the Guardians' offense. The Yankees took down the Pirates 8-5, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense. The Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Blue Jays, with Nick Martinez earning the win. The Red Sox came from behind to take a 6-5 victory over the Orioles, with Christian Encarnacion-Strand leading the Orioles.

Injuries and Availability Impact
Miami Marlins right-hander Max Meyer has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain, effective retroactive to July 19, 2026. The Chicago Cubs' Phil Maton has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right knee tendinitis. The San Diego Padres' Miguel Andujar has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right wrist fracture. The Baltimore Orioles' Adley Rutschman has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist inflammation.

Trades and Roster Movement
The Colorado Rockies acquired outfielder Landyn Vidourek from the Los Angeles Dodgers in a trade, sending right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen to the Dodgers. The Rockies also acquired right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso in the trade. The Chicago Cubs acquired right-hander Aaron Civale from the Athletics in a trade, sending right-hander Aiden Moffett to the Athletics. The Baltimore Orioles acquired outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in a trade for cash. The Tampa Bay Rays traded right-hander Trey Pooser to the St. Louis Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 13-4 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with the Guardians' offense dominating the game. Petey Halpin led the Guardians' charge with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Pirates 8-5**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel pitched 3 strong innings for the Pirates, striking out 5 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Martinez earning the win. Nick Fortes led the Rays' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Edge Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, coming from behind to take the win. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Max Meyer Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-hander Max Meyer has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain, effective retroactive to July 19, 2026.

top_news.title: **ROCKIES MAKE KEY ADDITION**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies acquired outfielder Landyn Vidourek from the Los Angeles Dodgers in a trade on July 20, 2026. In exchange, the Rockies sent right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen to the Dodgers.
